title: Pronoun sentences
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: pronoun sentences)
intro: Lesson 17: Personal pronouns: I, you, he, she. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

questions.q: Say: he is a student; she is a student.
Say 'you are tall' to a boy.
Pronoun sentences on the pupil PDF: complete eight sentences with the right pronoun and adjective form, then write three about people you know (no names needed: هُوَ / هِيَ).
questions.a: For example: أَنَا طَالِبٌ/طَالِبَةٌ؛ هُوَ قَصِيرٌ؛ هِيَ ذَكِيَّةٌ

questions.q: Extend: say three sentences about yourself with أَنَا.
questions.a: For example: أَنَا طَالِبٌ. أَنَا مِنْ لَنْدَن. أَنَا سَعِيدٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: why does أَنَا stay the same for boys and girls?
questions.a: 'I' is the same; only the adjective changes: أَنَا طَالِبٌ / أَنَا طَالِبَةٌ.

questions.q: You are speaking to Maryam. 'You are kind' is ...
questions.a: A) أَنْتِ لَطِيفَةٌ. To a girl: أَنْتِ with a feminine adjective.

questions.q: Think again: why two words for 'you'?
questions.a: It shows clearly whether you speak to a boy or a girl.
